indices: frame-local zero-based raw28B row IDs; valid compact is sensor finite XYZ and any XYZ nonzero before R/T; full leveled xyzi preserves raw row IDs, invalid XYZ is NaN; compact_leveled_xyzi uses compact_to_raw
pointset_sha: SHA256 ordered uint32 little endian raw row IDs; duplicate coordinates retain separate row IDs
components: raw_components includes all PA/PB pre-classifier components including rejected hard gates; hard_gate_pass false rows count only component diagnostics, eligible proposal must be supplied after quality gates
candidate: id, raw_indices, accepted, decision, score, association_anchor, scoring_centroid, track_id, track_segment; exact current scoring union only
evaluation: one-to-one coverage>=0.5 purity>=0.8; observed requires confirmed lost=0 plus accepted current members by same track/segment; partial unmatched_unknown; complete exhaustive=false unless reviewed window asserts all humans/negatives
features: RF51 existing extract output Float32; XGB69 RF51 plus six height bands fraction and X/Y p10-p90 widths, Float32; model XGB split thresholds Float32
pointnet: 256 floor(j*n/256) samples ordered current union, Float32 XYZ only, subtract sample mean, transpose Nx3 -> 3xN, no intensity, no scale normalization, repeated fill deterministic; existing weights immutable
qualification: BOUND_HUMAN_REVIEWED / PROPAGATED_CONDITIONAL / PARTIAL / UNKNOWN / INVALID_BINDING; source human alone not independent review
failures: background_deleted / cleanup_deleted / proposal_hard_rejected / proposal_unclustered / classifier_rejected / association_failed / coasting distinct; stage memberships permit overlap across PA and PB and ordered scoring union dedup
scope: offline real-data engineering and development regression; no independent blind test or device claim
